g.text: Figure 1 · Three views of restaurant ordering
Arrows indicate analysis moving from current work to a target and
then explicit operations; improvements remain hypotheses.
Check the refrigerator → write missing items → phone the supplier;
unanswered calls require another attempt. Time, omissions and
Show stock and suggested quantities → manager confirms → submit →
notify supplier. Goals are less repeated work, fewer omissions and
retained records; notification is not supplier acceptance.
